note: Fixtures for the CRITIC benchmark (rag/eval_critic.mjs). Each case is a realistic Concise lecture talk carrying EXACTLY ONE known defect, so a miss is unambiguous. The clean controls carry none — they exist to measure false positives, because a critic that rewrites healthy talks is its own kind of failure. Defect classes are drawn from what the harness and the blind judge have actually caught in this project, not invented: dangerous_number and drug_fabrication are the disqualifying pair from the PASS BAR; fabricated_guideline is the failure the judge found in claude-opus-5's own HFrEF output on 2026-07-26, which the automated detectors are structurally blind to; citation_misattribution is the wrong-PMID class; contradiction is the internal-consistency check. CLEAN CONTROLS, 2026-07-27: these are deliberately SHORT talks, and LECTURE_CRITIQUE_PROMPT check (4) instructs the critic to write missing content — so an APPEND of a treatment section is compliance, not over-eagerness, and the scorer now separates appends from rewrites of existing text.

cases.defect: Correction ceiling stated as 18 mEq/L/24h. The accepted limit is <=8 (some guidelines 10 in the first 24h). 18 would cause osmotic demyelination.

talk.title: Hyponatremia: Water Handling, Not Salt
talk.subtitle: ADH physiology, tonicity workup, and safe correction
summary_points: Serum sodium is a water problem, not a salt problem
Urine osmolality separates ADH-driven from water-loading causes
Correct slowly; the ceiling exists to prevent osmotic demyelination

visual_memory_card.bottom_left: SIADH is a diagnosis of exclusion

references.source: Spasovski G et al. Clinical practice guideline on diagnosis and treatment of hyponatraemia

sections.heading: Physiology: why sodium concentration is a water measurement
points: Serum Na reflects the ratio of total body solute to total body water
ADH binds V2 receptors on collecting duct principal cells, trafficking aquaporin-2 to the apical membrane
Baroreceptor-driven ADH release overrides osmolality in heart failure and cirrhosis
sections.mechanism: Free water retention dilutes serum sodium
sections.teaching_pearl: You cannot become hyponatremic on ADH alone - the patient must drink
sections.board_tip: Always pair serum osmolality with urine osmolality

sections.heading: Correction: rate limits and rescue
points: Correct sodium by no more than 18 mEq/L in the first 24 hours
Symptomatic hyponatremia with seizures warrants 3% hypertonic saline in bolus form
Relowering with desmopressin is appropriate if the ceiling is exceeded
sections.board_tip: Know the high-risk groups: alcohol use disorder, malnutrition, hypokalemia

cases.defect: "dapagliflozan" is not a real drug. The INN is dapagliflozin.

talk.title: HFrEF: The Four Pillars
talk.subtitle: Why each drug class earns its place
summary_points: Four pillars act on distinct maladaptive pathways
Start low, start several, titrate as tolerated
Benefit appears within weeks, not months

visual_memory_card.bottom_left: MRA if K and eGFR allow

references.source: Heidenreich PA et al. 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure

sections.heading: Neurohormonal blockade
points: RAAS activation drives fibrosis and adverse remodeling
Sacubitril-valsartan augments natriuretic peptides while blocking AT1
Beta blockade reverses catecholamine-mediated remodeling
sections.teaching_pearl: The pillars are additive, not sequential
sections.board_tip: Only carvedilol, metoprolol succinate and bisoprolol have mortality data

sections.heading: SGLT2 inhibition
points: Benefit is independent of glycemic control
Start dapagliflozan 10 mg daily irrespective of diabetes status
Expect a small early eGFR dip that is not a reason to stop
sections.mechanism: Natriuresis, improved myocardial energetics, reduced preload
sections.teaching_pearl: The eGFR dip is hemodynamic, not injury
sections.board_tip: Hold during acute illness with poor oral intake

cases.defect: Cites a "2026 AHA/ACC/ESC/WHF Universal Definition of Heart Failure". No such document exists - the Universal Definition is the 2021 Bozkurt consensus. This is the exact failure the blind judge found in claude-opus-5's own output on 2026-07-26, and the automated detectors cannot see it because it is not a PMID or DOI.

talk.title: Heart Failure Classification
talk.subtitle: Why ejection fraction categories keep moving
guideline_sources: 2026 AHA/ACC/ESC/WHF Universal Definition of Heart Failure
summary_points: Categories are defined by EF and by trajectory
HFimpEF is a trajectory, not a snapshot
Classification drives which trials apply to your patient

references.source: Heidenreich PA et al. 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure

sections.heading: The categories
points: HFrEF is an EF of 40% or less
HFmrEF spans 41 to 49% and behaves more like HFrEF than once believed
HFpEF requires evidence of elevated filling pressures, not merely a normal EF
sections.mechanism: EF is a crude surrogate for contractile reserve
sections.teaching_pearl: A normal EF does not mean a normal heart
sections.board_tip: HFpEF is a diagnosis requiring objective evidence, not exclusion alone

sections.heading: Why trajectory matters
points: Improved EF does not mean cured - therapy withdrawal causes relapse
TRED-HF showed relapse after withdrawal in recovered dilated cardiomyopathy
Classification determines which trial populations your patient resembles
sections.teaching_pearl: Do not stop the pillars because the EF normalized
sections.board_tip: HFimpEF requires a documented prior EF of 40% or less

cases.defect: The claim about azithromycin reducing exacerbations is attributed to reference [1], which is the MRC domiciliary oxygen trial. The MRC trial studied oxygen and mortality, not macrolides.

talk.title: COPD Exacerbations
talk.subtitle: What actually changes outcomes
summary_points: Exacerbations accelerate lung function decline
Oxygen is the only therapy with clear mortality benefit in chronic hypoxemia
Prevention is where the leverage is

references.source: Long term domiciliary oxygen therapy in chronic hypoxic cor pulmonale
GOLD 2024 Global Strategy for the Diagnosis, Management and Prevention of COPD

sections.heading: Acute management
points: Short-acting bronchodilators, systemic corticosteroids, antibiotics when sputum is purulent
Target oxygen saturation 88 to 92% to avoid worsening hypercapnia
NIV reduces intubation and mortality in hypercapnic respiratory failure
sections.teaching_pearl: Oxygen is a drug with a therapeutic window
sections.board_tip: Five days of prednisone is as good as fourteen

sections.heading: Prevention
points: Smoking cessation and vaccination are the highest-yield interventions
Chronic azithromycin reduces exacerbation frequency in selected patients [1]
Pulmonary rehabilitation after an exacerbation reduces readmission
sections.mechanism: Reducing inflammatory burden and infection frequency
sections.teaching_pearl: The best exacerbation treatment is the one you prevent
sections.board_tip: Screen for QT prolongation and hearing loss before chronic macrolides

cases.defect: Section 1 says insulin may be started before potassium is known; section 2 says potassium must be above 3.3 before insulin. The two statements contradict each other about the same decision.

talk.title: Diabetic Ketoacidosis
talk.subtitle: Fluids, insulin, potassium - in that order
summary_points: Total body potassium is depleted even when serum potassium is normal or high
Insulin drives potassium intracellularly
Close the anion gap before stopping the infusion

references.source: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2024

sections.heading: Initial resuscitation
points: Isotonic crystalloid restores intravascular volume and improves renal perfusion
Volume alone lowers glucose substantially before insulin is given
Start the insulin infusion immediately on arrival without waiting for a potassium result
sections.mechanism: Osmotic diuresis causes profound total body water and electrolyte deficits

sections.heading: Potassium and insulin
points: Serum potassium must exceed 3.3 mEq/L before insulin is started
Insulin shifts potassium intracellularly and can precipitate fatal hypokalemia
Replace potassium in the fluids once urine output is established
sections.teaching_pearl: A normal potassium in DKA means a depleted patient
sections.board_tip: Recheck potassium every two hours during the infusion

cases.note_clean: Revised 2026-07-27: the original said 'Benefit appears within weeks, not months' (debatable) and named only dapagliflozin (incomplete). Both critics corrected them and were RIGHT — the control was not clean. A false-positive control has to be genuinely unimpeachable or it measures the fixture, not the model.
